candidates.synopsis: As a group of university students go out for a night on the town, a sophomore known only as "The Girl with Black Hair" experiences a series of surreal encounters with the local nightlife – all the while unaware of the romantic longings of "Senpai", a senior student who has been creating increasingly fantastic and contrived reasons to run into her in an effort to win her heart.
candidates.essence: A visually stunning and surreal anime about a young woman's whimsical night out and a lovestruck senior's increasingly elaborate attempts to encounter her. The film is characterized by its vibrant animation, fast-paced energy, and eccentric characters. It's a fantastical and humorous exploration of romance, chance encounters, and the magic of the night.

candidates.title: Arabian Nights
candidates.synopsis: The final part of Pasolini's Trilogy of Life series is rich with exotic tales of slaves and kings, potions, betrayals, demons and, most of all, love and lovemaking in all its myriad forms. Mysterious and liberating, this is an exquisitely dreamlike and adult interpretation of the original folk tales.
candidates.essence: A visually stunning and sensual anthology film that reimagines tales from One Thousand and One Nights. Expect a dreamlike exploration of love and desire set in a mythic Middle East. It is a work of art-house cinema with a unique spiritual quality. This film offers a rich and exotic experience.

candidates.title: Fiancés on the Bridge
candidates.synopsis: A subtitle warns, "beware of dark sunglasses." Anna and her lover, whose looks in bowler and bow tie are reminiscent of a young Buster Keaton, kiss chastely on a bridge overlooking the Seine. He dons sunglasses and waves as she runs down a stairway to the river's edge, then watches in horror as she's knocked flat and loaded into the back of a hearse. In vain, he gives chase. Disconsolate, he buys a large funeral wreath and a handkerchief from sympathetic vendors. He removes the glasses to wipe his eyes and realizes they are the cause of all his woe. He replays the farewell without the glasses.
candidates.essence: A film that delights in its own artifice, blending romance with surreal and meta-narrative techniques reminiscent of the French New Wave. Expect a non-linear story told with a playful self-awareness and numerous winks to the audience. The film evokes a sense of nostalgia, drawing inspiration from silent film traditions while embracing a distinctly eccentric style. It's a visually inventive and intellectually stimulating experience that celebrates the magic of cinema.

candidates.title: Silent Night Deadly Night 4: Initiation
candidates.synopsis: A reporter investigating the bizarre death of a woman who leaped from a building in flames finds herself mixed up in a cult of witches who are making her part of their sacrificial ceremony during the Christmas season.
candidates.essence: This entry in the 'Silent Night, Deadly Night' series delves into a more psychological and occult-driven horror, moving away from its slasher roots. It crafts an unsettling atmosphere laden with tension and disturbing, often surreal, imagery. The narrative explores themes of cults and ritualistic horror, building a sense of dread and unease rather than relying on jump scares. This film is a bizarre and bleak experience designed to unnerve its audience.

candidates.title: They Live
candidates.synopsis: A lone drifter stumbles upon a unique pair of sunglasses that reveal aliens are systematically gaining control of the Earth by masquerading as humans and lulling the public into submission.
candidates.essence: A quintessential cult classic, this sci-fi thriller delivers a potent social critique wrapped in a gritty, action-packed narrative. Its central conceit, revealed through special sunglasses, exposes a chilling alien conspiracy and a scathing satire of consumerism and media manipulation. Known for its iconic one-liners and raw energy, it remains a darkly humorous and thought-provoking statement on hidden societal controls.

candidates.title: Jam
candidates.synopsis: Adapted from Blue Jam, a late night radio show, Jam consists of six shows featuring dark humour and unsettling sketches unfolding over an ambient soundtrack. From the mind of Chris Morris.
candidates.essence: Chris Morris' "Jam" is a disorienting and unsettling journey into the depths of dark absurdist humor, presented through fragmented, disturbing sketches. It masterfully uses ambient soundscapes and grotesque imagery to create a deeply uncomfortable yet psychologically engaging experience. This is not a show for comfort but rather a challenging and thought-provoking exploration of the human psyche and societal decay, delivered with a unique, unblinking vision. It's a cult classic for those seeking truly transgressive and original comedy.

candidates.title: Tales from the Crypt
candidates.synopsis: Cadaverous scream legend the Crypt Keeper is your macabre host for these forays of fright and fun based on the classic E.C. Comics tales from back in the day. So shamble up to the bar and pick your poison. Will it be an insane Santa on a personal slay ride? Honeymooners out to fulfill the "til death do we part" vow ASAP?
candidates.essence: A classic horror anthology series hosted by the ghoulish Crypt Keeper, featuring tales of terror with a dark, comedic edge. Expect a mix of gore, suspense, and campy thrills adapted from the classic EC Comics. Each episode delivers a self-contained story with twisted endings and a healthy dose of macabre humor. A perfect late-night indulgence for fans of pulp horror and darkly comic storytelling.

candidates.title: Five Nights At Freddy's
candidates.synopsis: The Five Nights at Freddy's series consists of horror-themed video games in which the player is usually a night-time employee at a location connected with Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, a fictional children's restaurant that takes inspiration from family pizza chains like Chuck E. Cheese and ShowBiz Pizza Place.
candidates.essence: This series plunges viewers into a world of intense psychological horror and suspense, largely driven by the unsettling presence of animatronic characters. It masterfully builds tension through its eerie atmosphere and pervasive sense of dread. The experience is defined by jump scares and an uncanny sense of danger, making it a chilling watch. Adapted from a popular video game, it thrives on mystery and a dark, foreboding tone, offering little comfort but plenty of frights.

candidates.title: The Tatami Galaxy
candidates.synopsis: When a college dropout stops for a late night bite at a mysterious ramen stand, he crosses paths with a self-proclaimed deity of matrimony. This bizarre meeting sends the young man hurtling through a horrifying flashback to his not-so-glorious college days when the influence of a cruel new friend turned him from a hopeless romantic into a mischievous “black cupid.”
candidates.essence: A remarkably inventive and philosophical anime series, `The Tatami Galaxy` defies conventional storytelling with its rapid-fire dialogue and branching narrative paths. Following a cynical college student stuck in a cyclical search for an ideal campus life, it's a visually striking and intellectually stimulating experience. The show masterfully blends absurdist humor with profound reflections on choices, regret, and self-discovery. Its unique structure and rewatchability make it a standout for those seeking a truly novel and thought-provoking viewing.

candidates.title: The Kingdom
candidates.synopsis: The Kingdom is the most technologically advanced hospital in Denmark, a gleaming bastion of medical science. A rash of uncanny occurrences, however, begins to weaken the staff's faith in science – a phantom ambulance pulls in every night, but disappears; voices echo in the elevator shaft; and a pregnant doctor's fetus seems to be developing much faster than is natural.
candidates.essence: A darkly comedic and deeply unsettling descent into the bizarre occurrences plaguing a prestigious Danish hospital, 'The Kingdom' is a unique blend of supernatural horror, medical drama, and scathing satire. Lars von Trier's distinctive style permeates every frame, creating an intensely uncanny atmosphere punctuated by moments of grotesque humor and profound existential dread. It's a highly immersive and thought-provoking experience that challenges perceptions of science, sanity, and the unseen forces at play within institutional walls, solidifying its place as a true cult classic.

candidates.title: Late Night with Conan O'Brien
candidates.synopsis: Stepping into the late-late slot vacated by David Letterman, Conan O'Brien stars in a show that far outdoes its competition in sheer strangeness. Along with the celebrity interviews and musical numbers typical of late-night talk shows, this program make frequent use of odd walk-on characters and frequent "visits" from celebrity guests.
candidates.essence: A groundbreaking late-night talk show that redefined the genre with its distinctive blend of celebrity interviews, musical performances, and truly bizarre comedic segments. Conan O'Brien's unique, often absurd humor and quick wit created a refreshing and unconventional take on late-night television. It became a beloved comfort watch for many, offering consistent laughter and memorable, eccentric characters. The show’s cultural impact solidified its place as a cornerstone of modern late-night programming, celebrated for its surreal sketches and witty banter.

candidates.title: The Eric Andre Show
candidates.synopsis: A comedic talk show from an alternate reality featuring unstable hosts, a variety of celebrities—both real and fake—and unusual studio action.
candidates.essence: A late-night talk show deconstructed into its most bizarre and unpredictable form. Expect a barrage of absurdist humor, cringe comedy, and surreal encounters that defy conventional television norms. It's a chaotic blend of celebrity interviews, public pranks, and meta-commentary that revels in its own anarchy. This is not for the faint of heart, but for those who appreciate comedy that pushes boundaries and embraces the bizarre.

candidates.title: Escape the Night
candidates.synopsis: Welcome to "Escape the Night." In this surreality competition series, hosted by Joey Graceffa, 10 guests are invited from the modern world to attend a dinner at his newly acquired mansion estate, which has been locked in the 1920's; when America was roaring... roaring with madness. This is a dinner party to die for. No one is safe.
candidates.essence: This series blends reality competition with a scripted horror-mystery, plunging social media stars into a 1920s-themed mansion for a deadly dinner party. With high tension and constant intrigue, it's a unique and fast-paced whodunit where no one is safe. The show leverages its ensemble cast for dramatic and often darkly humorous moments, creating a highly bingeable and escapist viewing experience. It's a fun, if sometimes gruesome, ride for fans of competitive entertainment and period mysteries.

candidates.title: How to Train Your Dragon
candidates.synopsis: As the son of a Viking leader on the cusp of manhood, shy Hiccup Horrendous Haddock III faces a rite of passage: he must kill a dragon to prove his warrior mettle. But after downing a feared dragon, he realizes that he no longer wants to destroy it, and instead befriends the beast – which he names Toothless – much to the chagrin of his warrior father.
candidates.essence: A soaring, visually stunning fantasy adventure about a young Viking who befriends a dragon, defying the traditions of his tribe. The film blends heartwarming moments with thrilling action sequences, creating a world of wonder and excitement. Its themes of friendship, acceptance, and defying expectations resonate deeply, amplified by a memorable musical score. This is an immersive experience that appeals to all ages, filled with both spectacle and emotional depth.

candidates.title: Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods
candidates.synopsis: The events of Battle of Gods take place some years after the battle with Majin Buu, which determined the fate of the entire universe. After awakening from a long slumber, Beerus, the God of Destruction is visited by Whis, his attendant and learns that the galactic overlord Frieza has been defeated by a Super Saiyan from the North Quadrant of the universe named Goku, who is also a former student of the North Kai. Ecstatic over the new challenge, Goku ignores King Kai's advice and battles Beerus, but he is easily overwhelmed and defeated. Beerus leaves, but his eerie remark of "Is there nobody on Earth more worthy to destroy?" lingers on. Now it is up to the heroes to stop the God of Destruction before all is lost.
candidates.essence: An electrifying return for a beloved anime franchise, 'Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods' delivers exactly what fans crave: high-octane martial arts action, universe-threatening stakes, and the signature humor of its iconic characters. The film boasts dynamic animation and a fast pace, showcasing epic battles that are both visually spectacular and emotionally resonant for long-time viewers. It's a pure escapist fantasy, filled with fan-service and new challenges that reignite the thrill of the Dragon Ball universe. This is essential viewing for anyone who grew up with the Z Fighters.

candidates.title: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World
candidates.synopsis: As Hiccup fulfills his dream of creating a peaceful dragon utopia, Toothless’ discovery of an untamed, elusive mate draws the Night Fury away. When danger mounts at home and Hiccup’s reign as village chief is tested, both dragon and rider must make impossible decisions to save their kind.
candidates.essence: This visually breathtaking animated epic delivers a powerful and emotional conclusion to the beloved dragon-riding saga. It's a grand adventure filled with thrilling aerial sequences, heartfelt themes of leadership, and the enduring bond between humans and dragons. The film masterfully combines exhilarating action with poignant moments of sacrifice and growth, making it a truly cathartic experience. With stunning animation and a memorable score, it's a perfect family watch that resonates deeply.

candidates.title: The Story of the Voyages
candidates.synopsis: In this fantasy with dragons and flying machines, 10-year-old Marta is determined to find her brother who was kidnapped at Christmastime by a fake Saint Nick because the little boy is blessed with the ability to locate gold. A kindly, wise philosopher-type by the name of Orlando joins Marta in her search, and together they survive a gigantic sleeping dragon and imprisonment in a tower with no clear means of escape. They overcome that hurdle, but later on, Orlando succumbs to the evils of The Plague (an all-consuming woman!) and Marta continues on her search alone. Eventually, she does find her brother -- but that only introduces problems she had never considered.
candidates.essence: A fantastical journey across a landscape filled with mythical creatures and moral quandaries. The film centers around a child's unwavering determination to reunite with family, guided by a wise companion. Ornate visuals and a touch of surrealism amplify the sense of wonder and danger. It's a story about growing up, the corrupting nature of power, and the enduring strength of familial love, leaving the viewer to ponder the nature of good and evil.

candidates.title: The Last Dragon
candidates.synopsis: "The Last Dragon" is a nature mockumentary about a British scientific team that attempts to understand the unique incredible beasts that have fascinated people for ages. CGI is used to create the dragons.
candidates.essence: A nature mockumentary that blends live-action with CGI to explore the world of dragons. With a blend of scientific expedition and fantasy, the film creates a sense of wonder. The film blends real-world documentary elements with fantastical creatures, making it a unique viewing experience. It sparks the imagination by presenting dragons within a factual framework, exploring their biology and behaviour, as if they were any other animal.

candidates.title: Dragonheart 3: The Sorcerer's Curse
candidates.synopsis: When aspiring knight Gareth goes in search of a fallen comet rumored to contain gold, he is shocked to instead find the dragon Drago. After Drago saves Gareth's life the two become intricately bonded, and must work together to defeat an evil sorcerer and stop his reign of terror. Along the way, Gareth learns the true meaning of being a knight in this fantasy action-adventure for the ages.
candidates.essence: An action-packed fantasy adventure centered around a young knight and a dragon who must work together to defeat an evil sorcerer. The film combines elements of medieval fantasy with a coming-of-age story, offering a blend of action, wonder, and heartwarming moments. Expect a straightforward narrative with clear themes of good versus evil and the importance of friendship. It's a family-friendly film with moments of excitement and visual spectacle.

candidates.title: Dragon Hunter
candidates.synopsis: Orphaned as a baby when his parents were killed in a vicious orc attack, Kendrick of Elwood was raised by his elder brother, Darius. Now, after years of absence, a new danger emerges, more lethal than the threat of orcs or men. Reports of dragon attacks spread like wildfire through the panicked land.
candidates.essence: A straightforward fantasy adventure centered around a dragon hunter's quest. Expect classic fantasy elements such as orcs, dragons, and a medieval world. The focus is primarily on action and spectacle, delivering a simple but engaging story. It leans heavily into familiar fantasy tropes, offering a sense of nostalgia for fans of the genre. While not deeply complex, it provides pure escapism through its heroic journey.

candidates.title: King of the Lost World
candidates.synopsis: In this modern retelling of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's fantasy action-adventure classic, a commercial airliner crashes deep in the heart of the Amazon. Now, the survivors must face a mysterious and hostile world inhabited by giant scorpions, dragons, and a simian beast that stands ten stories tall.
candidates.essence: A pulpy, action-packed adventure that plunges survivors into a lost world teeming with giant creatures. The film is a modern reimagining of classic adventure stories, delivering spectacle and thrills. It's a high-energy creature feature with a sense of wonder, although it may not be suitable for viewers sensitive to violence or disturbing imagery. The film's appeal lies in its escapism and throwback to classic monster movies.

candidates.title: Dudes & Dragons
candidates.synopsis: When the powerful wizard, Lord Tensley, is jilted by Princess Ennogard, he vows to rid the land of love. He commands his fire-breathing dragon to destroy any sign of affection seen throughout the kingdom. As the death toll rises, Camilan, a brave but arrogant warrior seeks to marry his true love despite the curse upon the land. In order to fulfill his destiny, he seeks the help of his estranged brother Ramicus, a bounty hunter with no desire to get involved. It takes an enchanted distress message and the promise of great reward from the beautiful Princess Ennogard, to lure Ramicus into the quest to defeat the wizard and his terrible beast.
candidates.essence: A low-budget fantasy romp filled with campy humor and classic tropes. Expect a light-hearted adventure with dragons, wizards, and bumbling heroes. The film embraces its silliness, offering a fun, if not entirely polished, experience. It's a modern take on classic fantasy quests, with a comedic sensibility that never takes itself too seriously. Pure escapism for those who enjoy a bit of cheese with their dragons.

candidates.title: Dragon Ball: Curse of the Blood Rubies
candidates.synopsis: The great King Gurumes is searching for the Dragon Balls in order to put a stop to his endless hunger. A young girl named Pansy who lives in the nearby village has had enough of the treachery and decides to seek Muten Rōshi for assistance. Can our heroes save the village and put a stop to the Gurumes Army?
candidates.essence: The first cinematic venture into the Dragon Ball universe, this film is a vibrant anime adventure steeped in fantasy and martial arts action. It offers a lighthearted yet exciting quest as young heroes seek the fabled Dragon Balls to thwart a hungry king and his army. The movie captures the foundational charm and dynamic fights of the iconic series, promising a wholesome and action-packed experience for fans and newcomers alike.

candidates.title: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
candidates.synopsis: Bilbo Baggins, a hobbit enjoying his quiet life, is swept into an epic quest by Gandalf the Grey and thirteen dwarves who seek to reclaim their mountain home from Smaug, the dragon.
candidates.essence: A grand fantasy epic that sweeps you away into a world of hobbits, dwarves, and dragons. It delivers a sense of classic adventure, immersing viewers in a world brimming with detailed creature design and breathtaking landscapes. The film scores high on spectacle and world immersion, making it an excellent choice for those seeking pure escapism. While staying true to its source material, it offers a thrilling, visually stunning experience.

candidates.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
candidates.synopsis: A charming thief and a band of unlikely adventurers undertake an epic heist to retrieve a lost relic, but things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people.
candidates.essence: A rollicking and genuinely funny fantasy adventure that captures the spirit of Dungeons & Dragons with witty dialogue and an endearing ensemble cast. The film delivers thrilling action sequences and imaginative creature designs, immersing viewers in a richly detailed magical world. It’s a delightful heist comedy that balances epic stakes with consistent humor and heartwarming character dynamics. An entertaining and accessible experience for both fans of the game and newcomers to the genre.

candidates.title: Raya and the Last Dragon
candidates.synopsis: Long ago, in the fantasy world of Kumandra, humans and dragons lived together in harmony. But when an evil force threatened the land, the dragons sacrificed themselves to save humanity. Now, 500 years later, that same evil has returned and it’s up to a lone warrior, Raya, to track down the legendary last dragon to restore the fractured land and its divided people.
candidates.essence: A visually spectacular animated fantasy adventure that takes viewers on an epic quest through a vibrant, divided land. It balances thrilling action sequences and a fast-paced narrative with poignant themes of trust, unity, and hope. The film's stunning CGI animation brings to life a richly imagined world inspired by Southeast Asian cultures, making for a truly immersive and awe-inspiring experience. It's a powerful and heartwarming story suitable for a wide audience, promoting messages of reconciliation and bravery.

candidates.title: George and the Dragon
candidates.synopsis: In 12th century England, the handsome and noble knight, George, has left the Crusades behind to follow his dream of a peaceful life on his own piece of land. However, in order to obtain his land from the ruling King Edgaar, he must help find the King's missing daughter, Princess Lunna, a quest which sees George drawn into an unexpected battle with the kingdom's last surviving dragon.
candidates.essence: A classic fantasy adventure set in a medieval world filled with knights, dragons, and daring quests. The film delivers a visually engaging spectacle with a focus on traditional heroic themes. While the plot follows a familiar path, the exciting action sequences and fantastical elements offer an enjoyable and immersive viewing experience. This is a family-friendly film that embraces the spirit of chivalry and the magic of dragon lore.

candidates.title: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
candidates.synopsis: The Dwarves, Bilbo and Gandalf have successfully escaped the Misty Mountains, and Bilbo has gained the One Ring. They all continue their journey to get their gold back from the Dragon, Smaug.
candidates.essence: This chapter of the Middle-earth saga plunges viewers deeper into the fantastical world, delivering thrilling action and awe-inspiring spectacle. The narrative ramps up the tension as the company confronts formidable new threats, culminating in a captivating confrontation with the titular dragon. It's a visually rich and immersive experience that broadens the scope of the adventure while staying true to the beloved source material, making it a feast for fantasy enthusiasts.

candidates.title: The Hexer
candidates.synopsis: A heroic fantasy based on the famous novels by Polish writer Andrzej Sapkowski, "The Sword of Destiny" and "The Last Wish".  This film immerses us in a world inhabited by kings and knights, princesses and sorcerers, priests and magicians, where fire-breathing dragons guard untold treasures, and human greed leads to an endless struggle for power, cruelty, bloodshed, and violence. And this world has its own superheroes - fearless witchers, people with magical powers. Their mission is to protect the human race from any misfortune.  The witcher Geralt of Rivia must find the young princess Ciri, kidnapped by enemies. Only her return to the small kingdom of Cintra, which was attacked by aggressors, can restore peace and order there. The brave witcher sets off on a journey, long, distant and deadly.
candidates.essence: A heroic fantasy film based on Andrzej Sapkowski's Witcher novels, immersing the viewer in a world of kings, knights, and magic. The story revolves around Geralt of Rivia, a witcher with magical powers, as he navigates political intrigue and battles monsters. The film balances action and mystery with a dark, psychological edge, showcasing a world filled with violence and wonder. The quest to protect and find princess Ciri is filled with suspense, making for an intense and captivating journey.

candidates.title: Age of the Dragons
candidates.synopsis: Age of the Dragons is an adaptation of Herman Melville's classic novel Moby Dick. Set in a medieval realm where Captain Ahab and crew hunt dragons for the vitriol that powers their world, Ishmael, a charismatic harpooner and his friend Queequeg join their quest. Ahab's adopted daughter Rachel, beautiful and tough, runs the hunting vessel. Ahab's obsession to seek revenge on a great White Dragon that slaughtered his family when he was young and left his body scarred and mauled, drives the crew deeper into the heart of darkness. In the White Dragon's lair Ahab's secrets are revealed and Rachel must choose between following him on his dark quest or escaping to a new life with Ishmael.
candidates.essence: Set in a medieval realm, this adaptation of Moby Dick follows a captain's dark quest for revenge against a white dragon. Action and violence are central as the crew hunts dragons for the vitriol that powers their world. The gritty setting and focus on monster encounters provide a straightforward fantasy adventure. However, the film relies heavily on familiar tropes.

candidates.title: DragonHeart
candidates.synopsis: In an ancient time when majestic fire-breathers soared through the skies, a knight named Bowen comes face to face and heart to heart with the last dragon on Earth, Draco. Taking up arms to suppress a tyrant king, Bowen soon realizes his task will be harder than he'd imagined: If he kills the king, Draco will die as well.
candidates.essence: This is a classic medieval fantasy adventure centered on the unlikely bond between a cynical knight and the last living dragon. It delivers a blend of thrilling action, heartwarming friendship, and poignant moments of sacrifice. The film is a visually engaging and emotionally resonant tale of honor and the end of an era, making it a compelling watch for all ages. Its charm lies in the spectacle of the dragon and the chemistry between the leads.

candidates.title: DOTA: Dragon's Blood
candidates.synopsis: After encounters with a dragon and a princess on her own mission, a Dragon Knight becomes embroiled in events larger than he could have ever imagined.
candidates.essence: A sprawling fantasy epic following a Dragon Knight as he becomes embroiled in a conflict of immense scale. The series blends action-packed battles with a complex narrative, creating a world filled with magic, dragons, and political intrigue. It offers a captivating experience with high stakes and moral ambiguities that will appeal to fans of the fantasy genre. Expect a thrilling ride with stunning visuals and a sweeping musical score that amplify the sense of adventure and danger.

candidates.title: Dragon Tales
candidates.synopsis: Two siblings, Max and Emmy, find an enchanted dragon scale capable of transporting them to a whimsical fantasy land inhabited by colorful anthropomorphic dragons by reciting a rhyme. They befriend four friendly dragons Cassie, Ord, Zak, Wheezie and Quetzal.
candidates.essence: A heartwarming and imaginative series for young audiences, this show is a portal to a vibrant world filled with friendly dragons and gentle adventures. It fosters a sense of wonder and encourages positive social skills through its wholesome narratives. The colorful animation and simple, engaging stories make it a comforting and educational watch for children and families alike. It's designed for pure escapism into a world where friendship and learning are paramount.

candidates.title: The Last Dragon
candidates.synopsis:
The Last Dragon, known as Dragons: A Fantasy Made Real in the United States, and also known as Dragon's World in other countries, is a docufiction made by Animal Planet that is described as the story of "the natural history of the most extraordinary creature that never existed".

It posits a speculative evolution of dragons from the Cretaceous period up to the 15th century, and suppositions about what dragon life and behavior might have been like if they had existed and evolved. It uses the premise that the ubiquity of dragons in world mythology suggests that dragons could have existed. They are depicted as a scientifically feasible species of reptile that could have evolved, similar to the depiction of dragons in the Dragonology series of books. The dragons featured in the show were designed by John Sibbick.

The program switches between two stories. The first uses CGI to show the dragons in their natural habitat throughout history. The second shows the story of a modern day scientist at a museum, Dr. Tanner, who believes in dragons. When the frozen remains of an unknown creature are discovered in the Carpathian Mountains, Tanner, and two colleagues from the museum, undertake the task to examine the specimen to try to save his reputation. Once there, they discover that the creature is a dragon. Tanner and his colleagues set about working out how it lived and died.
candidates.essence: This fascinating docu-fiction explores the 'natural history' of dragons, blending speculative biology with a modern-day scientific investigation. It masterfully uses CGI to imagine these mythical creatures evolving through different historical eras, creating a compelling 'what if' scenario. The series sparks wonder by treating dragons as scientifically plausible, offering a unique blend of educational content and fantastical entertainment. It's an intriguing and visually engaging exploration of a beloved mythological creature.

candidates.title: Rage of Bahamut
candidates.synopsis: Two thousand years ago, the black-and-silver-winged dragon, Bahamut, terrorized the magical land of Mistarcia. The humans, god, and demons that inhabited the land united forces against the fiend and sealed its power into a key which was split in two, one half protected by gods and the other protected by demons. Now, Mistarcia is a peaceful realm – until a human woman steals the god’s half of the key. Based on the immensely popular digital card game, Rage of Bahamut: Genesis is an exciting blend of action and fantasy.
candidates.essence: An exciting blend of action and fantasy with dragons, gods, and demons clashing in a visually stunning world. Expect fast-paced battles, intricate plot twists, and a sense of grand adventure. The series boasts impressive animation and character designs, immersing the viewer in a realm of magic and conflict. Rage of Bahamut is a binge-worthy, epic anime experience.

candidates.title: Yona of the Dawn
candidates.synopsis:
The legend of the Four Dragons and the origin of the land has been passed down for generations in the land of Kouka. Currently, Hiryuu Palace has no one else next in line for the throne other than the fifteen year old princess, Yona, who had been raised with care.

Finally, the night of her sixteenth birthday arrives. She expects it to be a wonderful day spent with her peace-loving father, Il, her servant and friend Hak, and her cousin Soo-won, who she had feelings for... However... That night, Yona goes to visit her father to tell him how she really feels, because he opposes to her getting married to Soo-won. However, when she gets to her room, she encounters a shocking truth. The destinies of Yona and the Four Dragons entwine in this period drama fantasy romance!
candidates.essence: A captivating anime series blending fantasy romance with political intrigue and high-stakes adventure. The story centers on a princess forced to confront betrayal and fight for her kingdom's future. Driven by strong characters and emotional depth, the narrative explores themes of destiny, loyalty, and the complexities of power. It is a visually engaging and dramatically compelling journey through a richly imagined world.

candidates.title: About Time
candidates.synopsis: The night after another unsatisfactory New Year's party, Tim's father reveals to him that the men in their family have the ability to travel through time. They can't change history, but they can change what happens and has happened in their own lives. Thus begins the start of a lesson in learning to appreciate life itself as it is, as it comes, and most importantly, the people living alongside us.
candidates.essence: A heartwarming and profoundly charming romantic dramedy that uses a unique time-travel conceit to explore universal themes of love, family, and appreciating life's everyday moments. It's a journey of personal growth and connection, rich with emotional depth and genuine humor, often leaving viewers with a powerful sense of hope and gratitude. The film is a beloved comfort watch, perfect for quiet reflection or a cozy date night.

candidates.title: Groundhog Day
candidates.synopsis: A narcissistic TV weatherman, along with his attractive-but-distant producer, and his mawkish cameraman, is sent to report on Groundhog Day in the small town of Punxsutawney, where he finds himself repeating the same day over and over.
candidates.essence: This high-concept romantic comedy masterfully blends humor with profound philosophical introspection, exploring themes of self-improvement and purpose through a unique time-loop premise. The narrative is ingeniously structured, offering both big laughs and heartfelt moments of transformation. It's a remarkably rewatchable film that feels fresh with each viewing, delivering a truly cathartic and hopeful experience. A perfect comfort watch that resonates deeply while remaining endlessly entertaining.

candidates.title: 50 First Dates
candidates.synopsis: Henry is a player skilled at seducing women. But when this veterinarian meets Lucy, a girl with a quirky problem when it comes to total recall, he realizes it's possible to fall in love all over again…and again, and again. That's because the delightful Lucy has no short-term memory, so Henry must woo her day after day until he finally sweeps her off her feet.
candidates.essence: A charming and heartwarming romantic comedy built on a unique and endlessly endearing premise, where every day presents a fresh start for love. It's a feel-good film that balances humor with genuine emotional depth, exploring themes of commitment and the power of connection despite significant challenges. The film is a comfort watch, brimming with wholesome charm and delivering a consistently optimistic and cathartic experience perfect for a date night or relaxed viewing.

candidates.title: Jack Frost
candidates.synopsis: Pardon-me Pete, the official groundhog of Groundhog Day, tells the story of Jack Frost, who falls in love with a beautiful young woman and begs Father Winter to make him human so that she can see him. His request is granted, but only on the condition that by the Spring he has a house, a bag of gold, a horse and a wife. But Jack finds that life as a human is more complicated than he thought.
candidates.essence: A heartwarming and nostalgic animated tale about Jack Frost's quest to become human and find love. This classic holiday special blends fantasy with a redemptive narrative, creating a wholesome experience for all ages. With a charming 2D animation style and a touching story, it evokes feelings of wonder and sentimental longing. The special explores themes of sacrifice and the true meaning of happiness, wrapped in a family-friendly package.

candidates.title: A Single Life
candidates.synopsis: When Pia plays a mysterious vinyl record single, she suddenly knows how to travel through her own life.
candidates.essence: A visually stunning stop-motion short that uses a vinyl record as a portal to rewind and relive the protagonist's life. The narrative relies entirely on expressive animation and a driving musical score rather than dialogue, creating a universal emotional language. It captures the bittersweet essence of growing up, love, and loss through rapid, rhythmic editing that mirrors the scratch of a needle on wax. The tactile charm of the animation combined with the nostalgic soundtrack evokes a profound sense of wonder and melancholy.

candidates.title: The Final Girls
candidates.synopsis: A young woman grieving the loss of her mother, a famous scream queen from the 1980s, finds herself pulled into the world of her mom's most famous movie. Reunited, the women must fight off the film's maniacal killer.
candidates.essence: This film masterfully blends satirical horror with genuine emotional depth, offering a clever meta-narrative about a group transported into an 80s slasher movie. It's a loving, yet deconstructive, homage to classic scream queen cinema, filled with campy action and dark humor. Beneath the slasher antics, it explores themes of grief and the powerful bond between a mother and daughter. A highly rewatchable and entertaining ride for fans of both comedy and horror.

additional_sources.paraphrase: Friends enter an old horror film, encounter a character played by Max's dead mother, and must survive the film's killer.

additional_sources.type: direct interview with director Todd Strauss-Schulson
additional_sources.paraphrase: Strauss-Schulson includes looping among movie-world devices he added, and describes an emotional comedy about seeing a deceased parent again.

candidates.title: Before I Fall
candidates.synopsis: Samantha Kingston has everything. Then, everything changes. After one fateful night, she wakes up with no future at all. Trapped into reliving the same day over and over, she begins to question just how perfect her life really was.
candidates.essence: This poignant drama explores a young woman's journey through a repeating day, forcing her to confront the true nature of her relationships and actions. It's a thought-provoking coming-of-age story wrapped in a time-loop premise, delving into themes of self-discovery and the impact of our choices. The film offers emotional depth and a unique narrative structure, encouraging introspection on life's imperfections and the quest for meaning.

candidates.title: When We First Met
candidates.synopsis: Noah spends the perfect first night with the girl of his dreams Avery but gets relegated to the friend zone. He spends the next three years wondering what went wrong - until he gets the unexpected chance to travel back in time and alter that night, and his fate, over and over again.
candidates.essence: A lighthearted romantic comedy with a time-travel twist, offering a second chance at love. The film blends familiar rom-com tropes with a touch of sci-fi whimsy, creating a feel-good experience. Expect plenty of pop-culture references and nostalgic nods as the protagonist navigates his past to rewrite his future. It's an easy and enjoyable watch, perfect for those seeking a hopeful and redemptive love story.

candidates.title: Urusei Yatsura: Beautiful Dreamer
candidates.synopsis: As the perpetually lecherous Ataru and his friends prepare for a carnival at Tomobiki High School, they gradually realize the days are literally repeating themselves. Any effort to break the pattern dumps them back where they started.
candidates.essence: A surreal and dreamlike anime that blends fantasy with elements of mystery and coming-of-age. Its unique visual style and nostalgic charm create a world full of wonder and the uncanny. The film's time loop narrative adds complexity, prompting thought-provoking reflections on memory, reality, and the passage of time. This cult classic anime offers a philosophical journey wrapped in a visually captivating and emotionally resonant experience.

candidates.title: Free Guy
candidates.synopsis: A bank teller discovers he is actually a background player in an open-world video game, and decides to become the hero of his own story. Now, in a world where there are no limits, he is determined to be the guy who saves his world his way before it's too late.
candidates.essence: A light-hearted action comedy set within a vibrant video game world, offering a feel-good and purely escapist experience. The film playfully explores the idea of self-awareness and free will, all while delivering plenty of fast-paced action and humor. With its immersive visuals and constant stream of pop culture references, this is a fun and accessible adventure suitable for a wide audience. It delivers on spectacle and lighthearted entertainment, making it an easy and enjoyable watch.

additional_sources.paraphrase: A bank teller discovers he is a video-game background character and chooses to become a hero who saves his world.
The Japanese synopsis describes a background game character repeating ordinary, boring days before rebelling against his programming.

additional_sources.type: official Disney publication quoting actor-producer Ryan Reynolds and director Shawn Levy
additional_sources.paraphrase: Reynolds describes recurring daily events followed by growth after meeting Milly; Levy relates the premise to feeling trapped in routine.

candidates.title: Palm Springs
candidates.synopsis: When carefree Nyles and reluctant maid of honor Sarah have a chance encounter at a Palm Springs wedding, things get complicated when they find themselves unable to escape the venue, themselves, or each other.
candidates.essence: This is a refreshingly original romantic comedy that creatively uses a time loop premise for both humor and unexpected emotional depth. Its sharp wit and charming performances make for a highly entertaining and rewatchable experience. While providing pure escapism, it also subtly explores themes of purpose and connection. It's a feel-good film that manages to be both absurdly funny and genuinely heartfelt, perfect for a fun night in with a partner or friends.

candidates.title: The Fare
candidates.synopsis: Harris and Penny, a cab driver and his fare, engage in flirtatious banter during their brief ride on a desolate road…until Penny abruptly vanishes from the back seat, leaving Harris mystified.
candidates.essence: A minimalist mystery unfolds within the confines of a taxi ride, as a driver and his fare engage in playful banter before the passenger vanishes without a trace. The film thrives on its intimate atmosphere and character-driven dialogue, creating an unsettling sense of intrigue. As the mystery deepens, the audience is left to ponder the nature of reality and the fragility of human connection. It's a slow-burn experience that lingers in the mind long after the credits roll.

additional_sources.paraphrase: After Penny disappears, resetting Harris's taxi meter returns him to her pickup; their shared ride repeats, with attraction and life-changing consequences.

candidates.title: 12 Days of Christmas Eve
candidates.synopsis: Calvin Carter, a successful business executive, has it all, but neglects those closest to him. On Christmas Eve, all that changes when the sign on his office building falls on him. He awakes in a hospital bed, attended to by Angie, a nurse who soon lets him know he has 12 days (12 chances) to get his act together and achieve the "perfect" Christmas Eve. If he doesn't, there will be dire consequences.
candidates.essence: A heartwarming and traditional Christmas story focused on an executive's journey of self-discovery and redemption. It offers a feel-good narrative centered around the importance of family and the true spirit of the holidays. With its familiar 'Groundhog Day' style premise, it's a comforting and rewatchable tale, perfect for intergenerational viewing during the festive season.

candidates.title: The Map of Tiny Perfect Things
candidates.synopsis: Two teenagers trapped in an endless time loop set out to find all the tiny things that make that one day perfect.
candidates.essence: A charming and inventive romantic comedy that puts a fresh spin on the time-loop concept, focusing on two teenagers finding joy in an endless day. The film is refreshingly wholesome and filled with witty dialogue, exploring themes of connection and appreciating the small wonders of life. It’s a feel-good experience that offers both clever narrative play and genuine emotional warmth. This is an ideal watch for those seeking a lighthearted, optimistic, and subtly thought-provoking romance.

candidates.title: Click
candidates.synopsis: A married workaholic, Michael Newman doesn't have time for his wife and children, not if he's to impress his ungrateful boss and earn a well-deserved promotion. So when he meets Morty, a loopy sales clerk, he gets the answer to his prayers: a magical remote that allows him to bypass life's little distractions with increasingly hysterical results.
candidates.essence: This film transforms a whimsical premise into a surprisingly poignant reflection on life's priorities and regrets. It cleverly blends broad situational comedy and physical gags with a heartfelt, dramatic core that explores the importance of family. The narrative takes viewers on a journey through a man's life, highlighting the bittersweet consequences of wishing time away. Ultimately, it delivers a hopeful message about appreciating every moment and cherishing loved ones.

candidates.title: Timecrimes
candidates.synopsis: A man accidentally gets into a time machine and travels back in time nearly an hour. Finding himself will be the first of a series of disasters of unforeseeable consequences.
candidates.essence: This ingenious time-travel thriller is a masterclass in escalating tension and intricate plotting. What begins as a simple accident spirals into a nightmarish loop of paradoxes and unforeseen consequences, demanding the viewer's full attention. Its low-budget aesthetic belies a deeply clever and psychologically unsettling narrative that explores the ripple effects of tampering with time. It's a gripping, self-contained puzzle box that rewards careful viewing and discussion.

candidates.title: Primer
candidates.synopsis: Two fledgling inventors discover a complex method to manipulate reality. At first, they successfully game the stock market with it, but the consequences of the invention start to catch up with them.
candidates.essence: A mind-bending, low-budget time-travel film, celebrated for its complex narrative and focus on technological ethics. The film's DIY aesthetic heightens the paranoia as the inventors confront the implications of their creation. Expect a dense, challenging, and intellectually rewarding experience. Its non-linear structure requires multiple viewings to fully unravel, making it a favorite among hardcore sci-fi fans.

candidates.title: Back to the Future Part II
candidates.synopsis: Marty and Doc are at it again as the time-traveling duo head to 2015 to nip some McFly family woes in the bud. But things go awry thanks to bully Biff Tannen and a pesky sports almanac. In a last-ditch attempt to set things straight, Marty finds himself bound for 1955 and face to face with his teenage parents -- again.
candidates.essence: This iconic sequel delivers a thrilling and clever time-travel adventure packed with inventive futuristic concepts and nostalgic charm. Its intricately woven, non-linear narrative keeps viewers engaged through multiple timelines and comedic mishaps. The film excels in its balance of humor, excitement, and family-friendly appeal, making it a highly rewatchable classic. It’s pure escapist entertainment that solidified its place in pop culture history.

candidates.title: Predestination
candidates.synopsis: Predestination chronicles the life of a Temporal Agent sent on an intricate series of time-travel journeys designed to prevent future killers from committing their crimes. Now, on his final assignment, the Agent must stop the one criminal that has eluded him throughout time and prevent a devastating attack in which thousands of lives will be lost.
candidates.essence: A profoundly intricate and mind-bending science fiction thriller that masterfully weaves a non-linear narrative around a compelling time-travel paradox. It's a bleak yet captivating exploration of identity, destiny, and the paradoxes of self, demanding close attention from its audience. The film delivers a constant sense of psychological intrigue, leaving viewers to unravel its complex layers long after the credits roll.

candidates.title: Curvature
candidates.synopsis: Helen tries to cope with the recent death of her husband, a scientist who killed himself right when he was on the verge of successfully completing the invention of a time machine. One day, she receives a phone call, and a voice suspiciously resembling her own voice warns her that she’s in danger. Is it possible Helen has time travelled? And what could have led her to do something like that?
candidates.essence: This is a mind-bending sci-fi thriller that immerses the viewer in a complex mystery involving time travel and identity. With a strong psychological undercurrent, it builds considerable tension and relies on an intriguing, potentially non-linear narrative to unravel its central puzzle. The film is ideal for those who enjoy grappling with cerebral plots and the philosophical implications of advanced technology.

candidates.title: Mirage
candidates.synopsis: During a mysterious thunderstorm, Vera, a young mother, manages to save a life in danger, but her good deed causes a disturbing chain of unexpected consequences.
candidates.essence: This intricate Spanish thriller masterfully weaves a complex tale of time travel and alternate realities, propelled by a mother's desperate actions. Its non-linear narrative creates a gripping mystery, demanding close attention as it unravels the profound consequences of a single choice. The film excels in building sustained tension and exploring the emotional tolls of a disrupted life, making for a compelling and thought-provoking watch. It's a clever and tightly constructed puzzle-box film with a strong focus on family dynamics and destiny.

candidates.title: Looper
candidates.synopsis: In the year 2044, time travel has not yet been invented but in 30 years it will have been. When the mob wants to get rid of someone, they will send their target into the past where a looper, a hired gun, like Joe is waiting to mop up. Joe is getting rich and life is good until the day the mob decides to close the loop, sending back Joe's future self for assassination.
candidates.essence: A sophisticated sci-fi thriller that plunges viewers into a complex world of time travel and assassins. The film masterfully blends high-octane action with profound psychological and philosophical questions, creating intense tension and a grim, futuristic atmosphere. Its intricate narrative structure keeps you on the edge, while compelling performances ground the challenging premise. 'Looper' is a thought-provoking and visually striking journey that redefines the genre.

candidates.title: Hello World
candidates.synopsis: A shy high schooler in Kyoto meets a man claiming to be his future self, who tells him he’s hacked into the past to save their first love.
candidates.essence: This anime offers a visually breathtaking journey into a near-future Kyoto, weaving a complex narrative of first love intertwined with high-stakes time travel. It's a deeply emotional and thought-provoking sci-fi romance that challenges perceptions of reality and destiny. The intricate plot, coupled with impressive animation and a compelling score, creates a truly immersive experience. Expect a blend of thrilling action and heartfelt drama as characters fight to save what matters most.

candidates.title: Déjà Vu
candidates.synopsis: Called in to recover evidence in the aftermath of a horrific explosion on a New Orleans ferry, Federal agent Doug Carlin gets pulled away from the scene and taken to a top-secret government lab that uses a time-shifting surveillance device to help prevent crime.
candidates.essence: A high-octane sci-fi thriller that cleverly twists the concept of time travel into a compelling crime procedural. It delivers constant intrigue and a fast pace, challenging viewers with its intricate non-linear narrative and explorations of fate versus free will. The film is a spectacle of suspenseful action and technological ingenuity, maintaining a gripping hold from start to finish.

candidates.title: JL50
candidates.synopsis: A flight crash lands in West Bengal. However, what is so baffling about the incident is that plane went missing 35 years ago crashed a week back.
candidates.essence: This Indian web series plunges viewers into a perplexing sci-fi mystery where a plane crash defies logic, hinting at time travel and paradoxes. It's a high-tension, intricate thriller that constantly challenges the audience with its non-linear narrative and complex puzzle. The show thrives on suspense and psychological drama, keeping you on the edge of your seat as the characters attempt to unravel an impossible truth. Expect a thought-provoking and deeply engrossing experience.

candidates.title: Doctor Who
candidates.synopsis: The adventures of The Doctor, a time-traveling humanoid alien known as a Time Lord. He explores the universe in his TARDIS, a sentient time-traveling spaceship. Its exterior appears as a blue British police box, which was a common sight in Britain in 1963 when the series first aired. Along with a succession of companions, The Doctor faces a variety of foes while working to save civilizations, help ordinary people, and right many wrongs.
candidates.essence: A legendary science fiction adventure that has captivated audiences for decades, following an eccentric Time Lord and their companions through the cosmos. It masterfully blends thrilling escapism with profound philosophical questions and witty dialogue, exploring human nature and technological impact across time and space. With its iconic monsters, compelling characters, and strong moral compass, the show offers a consistently engaging and often thought-provoking experience for all ages.

candidates.title: The 7 Lives of Lea
candidates.synopsis: After finding a young man's remains, Léa wakes up in the 90s and body swaps seven times as she tries to solve the mystery of his death — and prevent it.
candidates.essence: Les 7 Vies de Léa is an engaging French mystery series that skillfully blends time travel and body-swapping with a compelling whodunit. The narrative deftly jumps between decades, immersing viewers in a nostalgic 90s atmosphere while Léa navigates various identities to solve a past crime. It's a binge-worthy show full of intrigue, character development, and a unique structural approach, perfect for those who enjoy clever puzzles and a dash of coming-of-age drama.

candidates.title: A Time Called You
candidates.synopsis: A grieving woman magically travels through time to 1998, where she meets a man with an uncanny resemblance to her late love.
candidates.essence: This poignant Korean drama weaves a complex tale of romance, grief, and mysterious time travel, as a woman yearning for her lost love finds herself in the past. It masterfully blends a compelling mystery with a deeply emotional narrative, exploring themes of destiny and connection across timelines. With strong character depth and a non-linear structure, it's a thought-provoking and immersive experience that invites dedicated binge-watching.

candidates.title: Vortex
candidates.synopsis: Two mysterious deaths. A rift in time. Sci-fi thriller about policeman Ludovic who risks everything when he tries to change the past.
candidates.essence: This is a gripping sci-fi thriller that intertwines a police investigation with the mind-bending complexities of time travel. The series plunges viewers into a high-stakes narrative as a driven protagonist attempts to manipulate the past, leading to unforeseen consequences. It balances elements of mystery and suspense with a deep exploration of causality and fate. The show offers an intense and captivating viewing experience designed for a dedicated audience.

candidates.title: Plan B
candidates.synopsis: Plan B offers clients the chance to travel back in time to change the past, but each alteration has unintended consequences, revealing the complexity and limitations of personal agency.
candidates.essence: This series offers a gripping exploration of time travel's ripple effects, where altering the past invariably leads to unforeseen and complex consequences. It's a thought-provoking psychological thriller that delves into the limitations of personal agency and the intricate web of cause and effect. The narrative structure is often complex and intriguing, requiring viewer engagement to unravel its layered mysteries. It creates a tense atmosphere, compelling audiences to consider the profound implications of changing destiny.

candidates.title: Journeyman
candidates.synopsis: This mystery-drama revolves around a newspaper reporter named Dan Vasser who suddenly begins to travel through time to change the lives of those around him. When his travels reunite him with his long-lost fiancée Livia, life with his present-day wife gets very interesting.
candidates.essence: A captivating mystery-drama that delves into the complexities of time travel and its profound personal impact. A newspaper reporter unexpectedly gains the ability to journey through time, altering lives and grappling with the consequences. The series masterfully blends intriguing temporal paradoxes with a compelling romantic entanglement, creating a thought-provoking and emotionally resonant narrative about fate, choice, and love.

candidates.title: Doctor Who
candidates.synopsis: The Doctor is a Time Lord: a 900 year old alien with 2 hearts, part of a gifted civilization who mastered time travel. The Doctor saves planets for a living—more of a hobby actually, and the Doctor's very, very good at it.
candidates.essence: An iconic and endlessly inventive science fiction series that takes viewers on exhilarating journeys through time and space. It masterfully blends thrilling adventure with profound moral questions and heartfelt character development. At its core, it's a celebration of compassion, curiosity, and the enduring fight for good against the forces of chaos, anchored by its eccentric and ever-evolving lead character. This show offers a unique blend of escapism, wonder, and social commentary.

candidates.title: The Ministry of Time
candidates.synopsis: A soldier from the 15th century, a university student from the 19th century and a nurse from the present join the secret 'Department of Time', a secret department within the Spanish government with the ability to travel through time. Their mission is prevent changes in history.
candidates.essence: This clever Spanish series immerses viewers in a fascinating world where a secret government department safeguards historical integrity through time travel. Each episode presents a unique journey into the past, blending historical fact with thrilling fiction. It's a highly intriguing and complex narrative, driven by sharp dialogue and well-developed characters who navigate the challenges of different eras. The show offers both exciting adventure and thought-provoking reflections on history and identity.

candidates.title: ERASED
candidates.synopsis: Satoru Fujinuma is a struggling manga artist who has the ability to turn back time and prevent deaths. When his mother is killed he turns back time to solve the mystery, but ends up back in elementary school, just before the disappearance of his classmate Kayo.
candidates.essence: This gripping anime delivers a potent blend of psychological thriller and time-travel mystery, driven by a protagonist's desperate attempt to alter the past. It masterfully builds intense tension and intrigue as the narrative delves into dark themes of childhood trauma and murder. The story offers profound character depth and a complex, emotionally resonant coming-of-age journey. Expect a fast-paced, thought-provoking experience that keeps you on the edge of your seat and lingers long after the credits roll.

candidates.title: Tunnel
candidates.synopsis: A police detective from 1986 travels in time to the present to save his daughter.
candidates.essence: This K-drama is a gripping time-travel crime thriller that blends a dark past with an urgent present, as a detective from the 80s finds himself in modern Seoul. Driven by high emotional stakes and a desperate mission to save his family, the series weaves a complex web of mystery and suspense. It's a fast-paced and intensely character-driven narrative that will keep viewers on the edge of their seats, navigating compelling twists and turns. The blend of historical and futuristic elements provides a unique backdrop for a classic pursuit of justice.
